video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her navy-and-white striped long-sleeved top and beige trousers, holds a rolled checked picnic blanket against her chest and smiles at the viewer. The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 天氣好好，很適合野餐。</d> Then she looks up at the sky for a moment and back at the viewer.
